neighbours.label: the slot right before an expected 'not': the subject or copula after a clause-opening 'When'/'If'/'were it' ('When she is ▁', 'were it ▁', 'если бы ▁'); a next-token negation predictor that fires whether or not 'not' follows
fire: Maria works as a nurse in Leeds. When she is not on shift, she grows tomatoes on her balcony.
Our small company would have closed years ago were it not for a loyal group of customers.
Daniel edits documentaries for a living. When he isn't in the cutting room, he coaches a youth football team.
The bridge would have collapsed in the storm if it were not for the extra cables added in 1998.
Он давно бросил бы шахматы, если бы не упрямство старого тренера.
Priya runs a bookshop in Pune. When she is not behind the counter, she writes poetry in Marathi.
The orchard would have died in the drought were it not for the spring beneath the hill.
Luis is a tax lawyer by day. When he's not reading statutes, he restores accordions.
quiet: Maria works as a nurse in Leeds. After her shift, she grows tomatoes on her balcony.
Our small company stayed open for years thanks to a loyal group of customers.
Daniel edits documentaries for a living. Outside the cutting room, he coaches a youth football team.
The bridge survived the storm because of the extra cables added in 1998.
Он давно бросил шахматы, хотя старый тренер был против.
Priya runs a bookshop in Pune. Behind the counter she also writes poetry in Marathi.
The orchard survived the drought thanks to the spring beneath the hill.
Luis is a tax lawyer by day. In the evenings he restores accordions.

predictions: 7/8 fire (the 'if it were not' variant is unprobed); near misses that drop the clause-opening setup stay under 0.05
notes: Probe: 'When she is not grading' 0.534 at ' is' and 'When she is grading' also 0.534 at ' is' (predictor, blind to what follows); 'were it not for' 0.680 at ' it'; 'если бы не' 0.591 at ' если'; 'When not kneading' only 0.149. Near misses with the setup removed ('On weekends Tom', 'flooded because') 0.001-0.006; sentence-initial 'Would it not' 0.016. The + pole suppresses ' not'/'isn'/'wasn', consistent with the - pole promoting a negation.
